The older descent suggestion is mapped to the current John Glasgow-1065 account. Largest working family through 1850 grows from 1,010 to 1,013 retained profiles; separate components 430 to 429, multi-child roots 52 to 51. Four complete comparisons preserve all prior citations, the 1683 mother-name conflict and the old profile reference. The eight remaining pre-1650 accounts are reviewed separately without changing cohort membership or forcing a parent.
